speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Battery silent. All three shelter groups are clear. The evacuation corridor is secure.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: They drew a line through these families. Look at them now. No scanners. No walls. Just each other.

speaker: TITAN
text: Easy, little ones. There’s room for everyone. Take your time. Nobody’s closing this road behind you.

speaker: KAITO
text: We opened one checkpoint. How many more are still waiting for us?

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Then we make this more than an escape. Keep the corridor open. Let them choose where they go.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Recovered shipment manifest decoded. The siege battery drew power through a regional transit depot. Its communication towers coordinate the patrol network.

speaker: TITAN
text: They used those rails to bring the cages here. Let’s make sure the next train carries something better.

speaker: KAITO
text: Oceanus, Titan—you’re with me. We follow the rails. Then we take their eyes off this city.
